officialSourceObservation.colorContract: SPZLoader maps source color bytes through a Uint8Clamped COLOR_LUT using SH_C0/0.15 before creating a normalized color attribute; raw byte/255 is not the decoded shader input in general.

rejected: Raw SPZ color byte divided by 255 is a valid general replay input.
